_about: George Bird Grinnell's (1849-1938) collections of Plains Indian tales, told to him and set down in English: Pawnee Hero Stories and Folk-Tales (1889), Blackfoot Lodge Tales (1892), The Punishment of the Stingy (1901) and Blackfeet Indian Stories (1913). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. The tellers are named where Grinnell names them. His hunting and boys' books are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto). On 2026-10-17 every other English text by George Bird Grinnell at Gutenberg was added (7 more books; dates are as each title page gives them, and many are undated in the text), at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Second transcriptions of titles already here (0) and shared or misattributed files are listed in _excluded.

grinnell-blackfoot-lodge-tales: Blackfoot Lodge Tales: The Story of a Prairie People (1892)
grinnell-punishment-of-the-stingy: The Punishment of the Stingy, and Other Indian Stories (1901)
grinnell-jack-in-the-rockies: Jack in the Rockies: A Boy's Adventures with a Pack Train
grinnell-jack-the-young-explorer: Jack the Young Explorer: A Boy's Experiances in the Unknown Northwest
grinnell-jack-the-young-trapper: Jack the Young Trapper: An Eastern Boy's Fur Hunting in the Rocky Mountains
grinnell-jack-the-young-ranchman: Jack, the Young Ranchman: A Boy's Adventures in the Rockies
grinnell-jack-among-the-indians: Jack Among the Indians; Or, A Boy's Summer on the Buffalo Plains
grinnell-jack-the-young-canoeman: Jack the Young Canoeman: An Eastern Boy's Voyage in a Chinook Canoe
grinnell-jack-the-young-cowboy: Jack the Young Cowboy: An Eastern Boy's Experiance on a Western Round-up

_excluded.grinnell-other: When Buffalo Ran (PG 15189), Trails of the Pathfinders (53897), Beyond the Old Frontier (54125), the Jack books and Boone and Crockett volumes: history, fiction and hunting, outside a folk-tale batch
